activity.notes: ATLAS uses c.1011-1021 as Ibn al-Haytham's representative Cairo scholarly interval under the Fatimid Caliphate. Modern medical-history scholarship records roughly ten years of confinement ending with al-Hakim's death in 1021, during which Ibn al-Haytham wrote the Book of Optics and other scientific works.

sources.title: Ibn Al-Haytham: Father of Modern Optics — PMC
sources.citation_text: The reviewed scholarly article records about ten years of house arrest until al-Hakim's death in 1021 and states that Ibn al-Haytham wrote the Book of Optics during this period.
